theorems.statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid (m + 1) →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1 + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (m + 1 + k)) (u : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid k) (z : Euclid (m + 1 + k)) (ψ : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1)) m) (v : Euclid (m + 1)), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → IsSmoothForm ψ → DifferentiableAt ℝ u v → exteriorDerivative (affinePullbackForm (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint ι.toContinuousLinearMap) (-(ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint ι.toContinuousLinearMap z)) ψ) (z + ι v + ι' (u v)) (fun i => fderiv ℝ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) v (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) = exteriorDerivative ψ v (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))
